messages:
jordyn: Quick fridge PSA — there's an unlabeled container on the top shelf. Note says "help yourself to labeled lunches" but...not labeled. Quick poll: eat-at-your-own-risk or send to the lab for analysis? :thinking: 

sam: Eat it and report back. I'll craft an official taste-test form. :chef:

viv: Do NOT. Last time there was a mystery chili incident. Learned that lesson the hard way. :sweat_smile:

alex: I'll volunteer for sacrificial taste testing. When is lunch? 

kelly: also, if it's mine it's coffee cake. claim it by 3pm or I label it "mystery pastry" :raised_hands:

fridge-bot: fridge-temp-monitor: last door-open event recorded at 11:02am. No tagged owner metadata found. :thermometer:

maya: Vote options: 1) eat 2) compost 3) toss 4) sacrificial tester (alex) 

emily: voting 4. also bring napkins and an emergency ketchup packet. :ok_hand:

jordyn: Tally so far — 1: sam, 2: viv, emily, 4: alex, maya. Looks like Alex is doomed. :eyes:

alex: bracing. will live-stream if anything happens. Spoiler: will probably regret this. :camera_with_flash:

sam: If you survive we expect a detailed postmortem + photos. Include timestamp and snack taxonomy. :memo:

kelly: ps if unclaimed by 3pm I'll label it "may contain regret" and move it to the "free snacks" bin. 

jordyn: Okay plan: Alex demo at 12:30, bring tissues. May the odds be in your stomach's favor. :crossed_fingers:
